QUOTE: The Valgrind and MemorySanitizer modes are controlled by `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_VALGRIND` and `MBEDTLS_TEST_CONSTANT_FLOW_MEMSAN` (`mbedtls_config.h:2109-2142`). They are commented out by default
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer names the off-by-default Valgrind/MemSan test options but never says the facility is a separate testing facility that is explicitly not part of the library API.
